The firm delivers quantitative financial modeling, equity research support, market intelligence reports, and custom data analytics to global investment firms and corporate clients.

companies.name: ReGen Labs
companies.description: ReGen Labs (ReGen Innovation Labs) is an enterprise automation company based in Aerospace Park, Adibatala, Hyderabad. Founded by Gouthami Racharla, the firm builds contextual AI agent systems that automate complex multi-step workflows across HR, Finance, Sales, and IT operations to drive operational efficiency and cost reduction.

companies.name: Reclaim Protocol
companies.description: Reclaim Protocol is a zero-knowledge data verification platform operated by CreatorOS. It enables users and enterprises to generate cryptographic zk-proofs of claims directly from any website or API (such as employment, education, bank balance, or loyalty status) without sharing raw passwords, personal data, or relying on easily faked screenshots.

companies.name: RentAid
companies.description: RentAid (Rentaid Private Limited) is a rental tech and property compliance platform headquartered in Hyderabad. Built to eliminate deposit deductions and undocumented agreements, RentAid provides verified house and flat listings, timestamped room condition photographic proof, automated rent receipts, lawyer-vetted agreements, and short-term rental (STR/Airbnb) legal compliance tooling.

companies.name: STAG Innovations
companies.description: STAG Innovations (Stag Innovations Private Limited) is an engineering and hardware product development startup based in Hyderabad. The company specializes in turnkey hardware product design, embedded firmware, IoT sensor integration, PCB design, and intelligent automation systems for industrial and consumer smart devices.

companies.name: Sanaari
companies.description: Sanaari (Sanaari Software Solutions Private Limited) is an enterprise software development and digital transformation consultancy headquartered in Hyderabad. Sanaari designs scalable web systems, database management architectures, bespoke ERP modules, and cloud integrations for commercial enterprises.

companies.name: Sanyark Space Technologies
companies.description: Sanyark Space Technologies is a deep-tech space and defense-technology startup founded by former ISRO scientists. Sanyark is developing a unified Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite constellation that converges resilient Positioning, Navigation, and Timing (PNT) with secure mid-bandwidth communications. Utilizing software-defined payloads, phased array antennas, and on-board edge processing, the platform delivers jam-resistant, centimeter-level precision navigation for autonomous mobility, defense platforms, aviation, and critical IoT infrastructure.

companies.name: Scale.jobs
companies.description: Scale.jobs (Scalejobs Services) is an AI-accelerated job search and reverse recruiting platform. Combining human career associates with proprietary AI automation, Scale.jobs handles the repetitive burden of job applications—customizing resumes, parsing ATS job descriptions, matching candidate criteria, and submitting tailored applications on behalf of job seekers across US and global markets.

companies.name: Semex AI
companies.description: Semex AI is an early-stage deep tech artificial intelligence startup based in Hyderabad. Selected as part of T-Hub's flagship 'Blueprint' Deep Tech Founder Fellowship, Semex AI develops specialized machine learning systems and intelligent automation architectures aimed at enterprise workflow efficiency and commercial scale.

companies.name: Sense Health Technologies
companies.description: Sense Health Technologies is a deep-tech biomedical devices and AI health-tech startup. Incubated at IIT Hyderabad (i-TIC Foundation) and part of T-Hub's deep-tech programs, Sense Health develops proprietary AI-integrated sensing systems and ultra-low-power, portable ECG diagnostic devices designed for ambulatory emergency transit, hospital ICUs, remote patient monitoring, and continuous Holter tracking.

companies.name: SenseHQ
companies.description: Sense is an enterprise recruiting software and talent engagement platform. It empowers staffing agencies and enterprise HR teams to automate candidate outreach, schedule interviews with conversational AI, and track hiring pipelines.

companies.name: Seven Robotics (ProtonX)
companies.description: Seven Robotics develops intelligent autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) and automated guided material-handling platforms (including its flagship 'Proton' and 'ProtonX' series). The company's LiDAR- and AI-guided robotic systems seamlessly integrate into warehouse, manufacturing, and healthcare environments for flexible picking, goods-to-person dispatch, and automated internal material movement without structural facility alterations.

companies.name: Shoshin Tech
companies.description: Shoshin Tech (Shoshin Tech Private Limited) is an education-technology and personal well-being product studio based in Hyderabad. The company builds interactive digital platforms, creative tools, and tailored learning resources designed for K-12 schools, educators, and learners to foster holistic child development, arts, sports engagement, and mental growth.

companies.name: Sid's Farm
companies.description: Sid's Farm is a premium direct-to-consumer (D2C) dairy and farm-fresh milk subscription brand. Founded by IIT Madras alumnus Dr. Kishore Indukuri, Sid's Farm conducts 45+ daily quality and adulteration tests (checking for zero hormones, antibiotics, and preservatives) across raw cow and buffalo milk, curd, ghee, paneer, and butter, delivering farm-tested dairy daily to households across Hyderabad and Bengaluru.

companies.name: SignalX.ai
companies.description: SignalX.ai (SignalX Private Limited) is an AI-driven entity due diligence, compliance automation, and corporate risk intelligence platform. Built for risk management professionals, compliance officers, valuation firms, and M&A legal advisors, SignalX aggregates and analyzes data across hundreds of public and regulatory registries to automate comprehensive vendor due diligence, anti-money laundering (AML) checks, forensic analysis, and promoter risk screening.

companies.name: Silicon Business Solutions
companies.description: Silicon Business Solutions (Silicon Business Solutions Private Limited) is an enterprise software and IT systems provider based in Hyderabad. The company delivers enterprise resource planning (ERP) deployments, business process automation tools, database administration, and custom business applications.

companies.name: SincroSys Solutions
companies.description: SincroSys Solutions (Sincrosys Solutions Private Limited) is an IT services and software development enterprise based in Hyderabad. The company delivers enterprise digital transformation, cloud infrastructure management, custom software engineering, and strategic IT consulting services for global businesses.

companies.name: Sind Technologies
companies.description: Sind Technologies (Sind Technologies Private Limited) is an IT solutions and software engineering consultancy based in Hyderabad. The company delivers bespoke web application development, quality assurance and software testing, HR automation tools, and IT infrastructure support for commercial businesses and enterprise clients.

companies.name: Sioniq ERP
companies.description: Sioniq ERP (Sioniq Technologies) is a cloud-based enterprise resource planning software provider based in Hyderabad. The platform offers integrated business modules covering supply chain tracking, discrete manufacturing workflows, multi-warehouse inventory management, invoicing, and GST-compliant financial accounting for industrial enterprises.

companies.name: Soul of Pluto
companies.description: Soul of Pluto (Soul of Pluto Tech LLP) is an enterprise software studio headquartered in Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad. Backed by Sai Silks (Kalamandir) Group, the company develops full-stack digital retail infrastructure including Pluto ERP, Pluto PoS, Pluto HR (a comprehensive workforce and retail staffing platform), and real-time business intelligence systems.

companies.name: SpadeWorks
companies.description: SpadeWorks is an AI agent platform built specifically for trade contractors, HVAC technicians, plumbers, and home service providers. Backed by Y Combinator (W22) and headquartered in Hyderabad, SpadeWorks deploys 24/7 conversational voice AI agents that answer inbound calls, qualify leads, schedule dispatch jobs into field service software, and run automated customer follow-ups to capture missed revenue.

companies.name: Spicenet
companies.description: Spicenet (Spicenet Telecom Private Limited) is a network infrastructure and telecommunications engineering provider headquartered in Hyderabad. The company delivers enterprise-grade fiber deployment, structured LAN/WAN cabling, optical transport networks, wireless networking installations, and managed connectivity support for commercial campuses and telecom operators.

companies.name: Sprinklr
companies.description: Sprinklr provides an enterprise unified customer experience management platform powered by proprietary AI. Founded by Ragy Thomas, Sprinklr's R&D hub in Hyderabad develops high-scale social data ingestion pipelines, automated content generation tools, and multi-modal customer sentiment engines processing billions of data points daily.

companies.name: SreeAL
companies.description: SreeAL (Sreeal Technologies) is an IoT hardware and industrial automation startup based in Hyderabad. The firm engineers smart sensors, industrial remote monitoring systems, and embedded hardware controllers to facilitate predictive maintenance and factory digitization.

companies.name: StaTwig
companies.description: StaTwig (Statwig Technology Services) is an IoT and blockchain-powered supply chain monitoring platform. Incubated at T-Hub and backed by the UNICEF Innovation Fund and World Economic Forum, StaTwig's flagship platform 'VaccineLedger' provides tamper-proof, real-time tracking of cold-chain life sciences, perishable food, and biopharmaceuticals—preventing temperature failures, counterfeits, and inventory spoilage.

companies.name: Startoon Labs
companies.description: Startoon Labs is an ISO 13485-certified medical device and deep-tech healthcare startup. Founded by IIT and IIM alumni and incubated at WE-Hub and AIC-T-Hub, the company developed 'Pheezee'—a patented, USFDA-registered wearable diagnostic device that measures muscle activity (sEMG) and joint range of motion (ROM) to objectively track, document, and quantify patient recovery post neurological and musculoskeletal injuries.

companies.name: StelX Dynamics
companies.description: StelX Dynamics is an advanced robotics and deep-tech aerospace startup. Incubated at T-Hub Hyderabad and a recipient of the Boeing BUILD innovation grant, StelX develops edge AI-enabled autonomous UAVs and planetary rovers engineered to execute surveillance, threat detection, and tactical missions in GPS-denied, jammed, or communication-restricted environments without human intervention.

companies.name: Storyvord
companies.description: Storyvord is an AI-powered film production and creative project management OS. Inducted into T-Hub's flagship Blueprint Deep Tech Fellowship cohort alongside global accelerators like Startupbootcamp and SINE, Storyvord functions as an autonomous AI co-producer that cuts film pre-production workflows from weeks to minutes by automating script breakdowns, multi-country budget forecasting, location compliance, and verified crew matching for filmmakers and production houses.

companies.name: Student Tribe
companies.description: Student Tribe (formerly StuMagz / Right Process Infotech) is a youth engagement, student community, and gig platform headquartered in Hyderabad. Connecting over a million students across 500+ campuses with brands, Student Tribe provides college students with paid brand gigs, campus ambassador roles, verified internships, hackathons, and curated skill development programs.

companies.name: Subtl.ai
companies.description: Subtl.ai is an enterprise search and generative document intelligence platform originated out of the Language Technologies Research Centre (LTRC) at IIIT Hyderabad. The startup builds secure, on-premise neural search engines trained on private organizational documentation, allowing banks, enterprises, and research teams to extract verified answers, summarize complex policies, and automate document retrieval with zero data leakage.

companies.name: SuccessMetric
companies.description: SuccessMetric is a performance marketing and digital analytics consultancy based in Hyderabad. The agency builds data-driven customer acquisition models, manages end-to-end paid advertising funnels across Google and Meta, and optimizes conversion rate architectures for B2B and D2C brands.

companies.name: Swipe
companies.description: Swipe (Nextspeed Technologies) is an invoicing, billing, and accounting platform built for small and medium businesses (SMBs) and freelancers in India. Backed by Y Combinator, Swipe enables merchants to generate GST-compliant invoices in under 10 seconds, dispatch bills directly via WhatsApp and SMS, automate payment reconciliation, track inventory, and file GSTR reports seamlessly.

companies.name: Sync
companies.description: Sync (Sync Labs, YC W24) is a generative AI infrastructure company developing foundational models for real-time video generation, precise lip-synchronization, and visual dubbing. Founded by Prady Modukuru, Rudrabha Mukhopadhyay, Prajwal K R, and Pavan Reddy, Sync originated from research at IIIT Hyderabad's CVIT lab and provides low-latency APIs allowing developers to synchronize human lip motion to audio in any language in real time.

companies.name: T-Works
companies.description: T-Works (T-Works Foundation) is an initiative of the Government of Telangana and India's largest rapid prototyping facility. Spanning a 78,000 sq. ft. campus in Hyderabad's Knowledge City, T-Works equips innovators, hardware startups, researchers, and corporates with state-of-the-art machinery—including industrial 3D printing, CNC machining, laser cutting, PCB fabrication, and testing labs—to turn hardware concepts into production-ready physical prototypes.

companies.name: TRiDE Mobility
companies.description: TRiDE Mobility (by Tride Innovative Technologies) is an electric vehicle commerce, financing, and battery management ecosystem. Accelerated through the AIC T-Hub 'Charge' mobility program, the platform provides a unified multi-brand two-wheeler EV discovery marketplace, paperless digital financing, battery performance telemetry, and post-purchase servicing to accelerate consumer EV adoption.

companies.name: TVISHA
companies.description: Tvisha Technologies (Tvisha Technologies Private Limited) is an enterprise software engineering and SaaS product development company headquartered in Hyderabad. Tvisha creates digital workflows, bespoke CRM/ERP platforms, and is the creator of Troop Messenger—a secured, encrypted enterprise team collaboration and instant messaging platform.

companies.name: TakeMe2Space
companies.description: TakeMe2Space is a deeptech spacetech venture developing standardized satellite buses, subsystems, and orbital AI data center infrastructure. Through proprietary radiation-shielding coatings that allow commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) terrestrial processors to operate reliably in low-Earth orbit (LEO), the company enables real-time edge AI compute and accessible orbital experimentation.

companies.name: TeamWA
companies.description: TeamWA is a conversational marketing and customer communication platform based in Hyderabad. The company enables businesses to automate marketing campaigns, sales funnels, and customer support via the official WhatsApp Business API, offering shared team inboxes, automated chatbots, and CRM sync.

companies.name: Tech Cloud ERP
companies.description: Tech Cloud ERP (Tech Cloud ERP Software Solutions Private Limited) is an enterprise resource planning software platform based in Hyderabad. The company builds modular, web-based cloud ERP solutions tailored for small and mid-sized manufacturing enterprises, providing real-time automation across supply chains, inventory control, production scheduling, finance, GST compliance, and multi-branch operations.

companies.name: TechBHP
companies.description: TechBHP is an automotive engineering and connected vehicle software solutions provider based in Hyderabad. The company builds telemetry tracking devices, OBD-II diagnostic integrations, smart vehicle fleet monitoring tools, and automotive software dashboards.

companies.name: TechVedika
companies.description: TechVedika is an AI solutions company and digital product engineering studio. Headquartered in Hyderabad, TechVedika builds specialized computer vision models, predictive ML algorithms, and IoT edge intelligence platforms for healthcare, retail, logistics, and manufacturing enterprises, alongside incubating proprietary SaaS platforms like SportVot and AI vision suites.

companies.name: TechZert
companies.description: TechZert (Techzert Software Solutions Private Limited) is an enterprise software consulting and IT engineering company based in Hyderabad. TechZert delivers microservices architectures, cloud application development, enterprise ERP/CRM integration, and automated QA testing.

companies.name: Tenet Diagnostics
companies.description: Tenet Diagnostics (Tenet Medcorp Private Limited) is a premium diagnostic laboratory and medical imaging chain headquartered in Hyderabad. Equipped with high-throughput laboratory automation and radiology suites (3T MRI, 128 Slice CT, 3D Mammography), Tenet provides comprehensive clinical pathology, genomics testing, corporate health assessments, and doorstep sample collections.

companies.name: TensorGo
companies.description: TensorGo is an artificial intelligence and deep-tech platform specializing in generative AI, computer vision, deep learning, and natural language processing. The company builds low-code neural network deployment platforms (PaaS and APIaaS), delivering scalable AI tools for virtual try-on, automated image restoration, conversational AI, and driver safety monitoring across retail, media, and enterprise sectors.

companies.name: The Corpus Group
companies.description: The Corpus Group (Corpus Operations Private Limited) is a media technology and OTT engineering solutions company headquartered in Hyderabad. Corpus develops end-to-end interactive TV ecosystems, Smart TV middleware, multi-screen OTT video streaming applications, and targeted monetization engines for broadcasters and telcos globally.

companies.name: ThoughtSpot
companies.description: ThoughtSpot is an AI-powered search and analytics platform that turns business data into natural language queries and dynamic interactive visualizations. Its engineering hub in Hyderabad engineers core distributed backend systems, query processing engines, and cloud analytics infrastructure.

companies.name: Tiny Tactics
companies.description: Tiny Tactics is an indie mobile game development studio building high-retention casual and mid-core games designed for long-term player engagement. The studio specializes in narrative-driven match-3 puzzles, casual simulation, and strategy mechanics tailored for a global audience.

companies.name: Tohands
companies.description: Tohands builds smart business calculators and IoT ledger hardware integrated with cloud-connected mobile software. Designed for small retailers and kirana stores, the device features dedicated Cash In / Cash Out buttons, real-time sync, and receipt printing to eliminate manual khata book errors without requiring expensive POS setups.

companies.name: Track3D
companies.description: Track3D (formerly ConstructN) is an AI-first reality intelligence and construction progress tracking platform. Operating an India development and engineering center in Hyderabad alongside US headquarters, Track3D turns visual reality capture data (drones, 360 cameras, laser LiDAR scanners, and mobile feeds) into automated schedule deviations, trade partner coordination workflows, and BIM-aligned progress intelligence for general contractors and commercial asset owners.

companies.name: Tractrix Opto Dynamics
companies.description: Tractrix Opto Dynamics is a deep-tech aerospace and defense technology company. Incubated across Hyderabad's deep-tech network and backed by iDEX (Innovations for Defence Excellence), the company specializes in indigenous design, precision simulation, thermal imaging, and advanced prototyping of critical electro-optical and opto-mechanical assemblies for aerial surveillance, reconnaissance, and space payloads.

companies.name: Trans India
companies.description: Trans India (operating as TransIn) is a tech-enabled freight exchange and logistics marketplace. The platform connects fleet owners, individual truckers, and transport brokers with enterprise shippers to streamline on-demand vehicle discovery, load matching, consignment tracking, and freight capacity utilization across inter-city transport corridors.

companies.name: Truveta
companies.description: Truveta is a healthcare data and AI intelligence platform providing complete, de-identified real-world clinical data from top US health systems to advance drug discovery, regulatory compliance, and patient care. Its India engineering subsidiary (Truveta India Private Limited) drives core platform infrastructure, ML pipelines, and clinical terminologies from Hyderabad.

companies.name: TurboHire
companies.description: TurboHire is an enterprise talent acquisition platform that uses AI and NLP to transform resume repositories into structured candidate networks. Its platform automates high-volume candidate sourcing, resume screening, collaborative interview scheduling, and evaluation workflows for global enterprises.

companies.name: Tutorac
companies.description: Tutorac is an edtech platform and global learning marketplace connecting students with vetted industry tutors and educators. It offers interactive live tutoring, specialized IT upskilling bootcamps, and comprehensive competitive exam preparation (including JEE and NEET).

companies.name: Uber Tech Center
companies.description: Uber Tech Center Hyderabad is one of Uber's largest engineering and product innovation hubs globally. Teams in Hyderabad build high-scale rider and driver matching systems, high-precision geospatial services, risk and compliance infrastructure, and financial tech platforms.

companies.name: UnoCareer
companies.description: UnoCareer (Unocareer Services Private Limited) is an edtech and talent recruitment enablement platform headquartered in Hyderabad. UnoCareer bridges academia and corporate hiring by providing standardized employability tests, technical skill assessments, AI-driven candidate matching, and automated campus placement drives.

companies.name: UrbanKisaan
companies.description: UrbanKisaan builds automated hydroponic vertical farms and proprietary plant biology foundation models. Its technology enables pesticide-free produce cultivation with 95% less water usage while leveraging controlled-environment chambers to dramatically accelerate crop breeding cycles.

companies.name: Vaave
companies.description: Vaave (by Coherendz India) is a cloud-based SaaS platform dedicated to building and managing institutional alumni networks. The platform helps universities, colleges, and schools automate alumni database management, organize reunions, coordinate fundraising campaigns, manage mentorship programs, and facilitate exclusive job and internship boards.

companies.name: Vahn
companies.description: Vahn is an enterprise mobility and logistics fintech company headquartered in Hyderabad. Inducted into T-Hub's Blueprint Deep Tech Fellowship cohort, Vahn builds an integrated mobile platform for commercial trucking fleets that centralizes diesel, toll, and trip expense payments alongside real-time vehicle telematics, automated digital trip sheets, and predictive maintenance analytics to drive fleet profitability.

companies.name: Vasista
companies.description: Vasista (Vasista Enterprise Solutions Private Limited) is a vertical SaaS and agritech enterprise software provider headquartered in Hyderabad. The company builds specialized ERP and supply chain automation software tailored specifically for dairy processors, dairy cooperatives, and agri-enterprises—automating farmer milk procurement, quality testing, cold-chain logistics, and retail distribution.

companies.name: Vectorform
companies.description: Vectorform (Vectorform India) is a global digital product innovation and design consultancy with its India engineering center in Hyderabad. Vectorform designs and develops digital products, spatial computing interfaces (AR/VR/MR), IoT software ecosystems, and interactive customer journeys for Fortune 500 brands.

companies.name: Vembi Technologies
companies.description: Vembi Technologies is an assistive hardware and inclusive edtech company designing digital learning aids for visually impaired children. Incubated at IIIT Bangalore and supported by Microsoft AI4Accessibility and Vision Empower, Vembi builds patented low-cost electronic braille readers and multimodal tactile tools (such as Hexis and Iris) that provide real-time braille translation, audio feedback, and digital book navigation in regional languages.

companies.name: Vivifi India
companies.description: Vivifi India Finance (Vivifi India Finance Private Limited) is an RBI-registered non-banking financial company (NBFC) and digital lending fintech platform headquartered in Hyderabad. Vivifi delivers accessible credit lines and digital loan products through its flagship brands FlexSalary and FlexPay, extending unsecured sachet-sized credit lines, salary-linked advances, and flexible repayment financing to underserved and under-banked consumers across Tier-2 and Tier-3 India.

companies.name: Vixspace
companies.description: Vixspace (Vixspace Technologies) is an immersive technology and digital experience studio based in Hyderabad. The company builds augmented reality, virtual reality, 3D product configurators, and real-time interactive metaverse environments for real estate, industrial training, and retail applications.

companies.name: Vizen Life Sciences
companies.description: Vizen Life Sciences is a life sciences, clinical safety, and pharmacovigilance solutions provider. Based out of Hyderabad, the company specializes in global safety surveillance, aggregate reporting, signal detection, risk management plans, and clinical data management services to ensure regulatory compliance and patient safety for global biopharmaceutical and generic drug developers.

companies.name: WEB ERA
companies.description: WEB ERA (Web Era Infotech) is an established web development and digital transformation consultancy based in Hyderabad. The firm delivers end-to-end enterprise web applications, e-commerce storefronts, CMS deployments, and digital branding solutions for commercial businesses.

companies.name: Way2News
companies.description: Way2News (Way2Online Interactive India Private Limited) is a vernacular hyperlocal digital media platform headquartered in Hyderabad. Delivering short-form curated news across Telugu, Tamil, and other regional Indian languages, Way2News utilizes an extensive grassroots stringer network paired with AI-driven content moderation to provide real-time village, mandal, and district-level reporting.

companies.name: Wehouse
companies.description: Wehouse (formerly Hocomoco) is a tech-powered proptech and home construction company. The platform provides full-lifecycle residential and commercial construction services—including architectural design, structural engineering, government approvals, vetted material procurement, and interior design—backed by a proprietary live dashboard and CCTV e-monitoring system that offers fixed-price and milestone transparency to home builders.

companies.name: Wexa AI
companies.description: Wexa AI is an enterprise context governance and AI coworker orchestration platform. Built to make autonomous AI agents enterprise-ready, Wexa operates a high-speed native context graph engine that connects live business data from ERPs, CRMs, and databases into governed context planes. The system enforces real-time policy gates, human-in-the-loop approvals, and immutable hash-chained audit trails before agents execute high-risk enterprise actions.

companies.name: Windo
companies.description: Windo is a mobile-first e-commerce storefront builder and social commerce platform operated by Rare Bits Technology. It empowers micro-entrepreneurs, Instagram creators, solopreneurs, and D2C brands to launch customizable online stores in minutes directly from their Instagram feed, manage inventories, integrate regional payment gateways, and automate last-mile order logistics.

companies.name: Wisdom Overseas
companies.description: Wisdom Overseas (Wisdom Overseas Educational Services) is a global higher education and overseas admission consultancy headquartered in Hyderabad. The consultancy provides end-to-end guidance for Indian students seeking MBBS and medical degrees in universities across Europe, Central Asia, and the Americas, handling university selection, visa processing, and documentation.

companies.name: XDLINX Space Labs

companies.description: Acquink (formerly Enixta Innovations / Acquink Solutions Private Limited) is an artificial intelligence and natural language processing platform headquartered in Hyderabad. Powered by its proprietary Multi-Aspect Sentiment Intelligence (MASI) engine, Acquink ingests and analyzes millions of unstructured product reviews, social discussions, and video feedback to extract granular, attribute-level customer sentiment—enabling enterprise consumer brands like Samsung, Flipkart, and boAt to identify product deficiencies, benchmark competitors, and drive on-page conversion with automated shopper review summaries.

companies.name: Aiden AI
companies.description: Aiden AI (Aiden AI Private Limited) is a healthcare AI and clinical intelligence platform with development and operations based in Knowledge City, Hyderabad. The company builds deep-learning solutions for hospital networks and healthcare providers, automating clinical documentation, autonomous medical coding (ICD-10/CPT), prior authorizations, and revenue cycle management (RCM) to eliminate administrative burden and billing leakage.

companies.name: Beacon.li
companies.description: Beacon.li is an AI-powered enterprise software adoption and orchestration platform based in Hyderabad. The company engineers autonomous AI product assistants and an Action Orchestrator that sit across enterprise applications to automate complex implementation workflows, guide user execution, and accelerate software adoption across global teams.

companies.name: Book My Chef
companies.description: Book My Chef (IdeaDeck Innovations Private Limited) is a food experience and culinary marketplace platform incubated at T-Hub, Hyderabad. The platform connects consumers and corporate hosts with vetted private chefs, mixologists, and catering teams for curated at-home multi-course dining, intimate gatherings, and large-scale celebrations.

companies.name: Broken Atom
companies.description: Broken Atom (Broken Atom Technologies Private Limited) is a developer tooling and low-code/no-code engineering platform based in Madhapur, Hyderabad. The platform allows software engineers and product teams to visually build, manage, and deploy production-ready full-stack web and mobile applications with automated backend generation, real-time database schema modeling, and direct Git sync.

companies.name: Cenna
companies.description: Cenna (Cenna Systems Inc. / Cenna Systems India Private Limited) is an ambient clinical intelligence and revenue cycle AI platform. The company engineers healthcare AI models that automate physician charting, extract structured clinical concepts, and streamline administrative revenue cycle operations for hospital networks and provider systems.

companies.name: CloudEvolve
companies.description: CloudEvolve (CloudEvolve Internet Services Private Limited) is a cloud engineering, modern infrastructure, and DevOps consulting firm based in the Kondapur / HITEC City corridor of Hyderabad. The company specializes in architecting and orchestrating secure, multi-cloud platforms across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, offering microservices modernization, Kubernetes orchestration, CI/CD pipeline automation, and 24/7 managed cloud operations for enterprises.

companies.name: Coresonant Systems
companies.description: Coresonant Systems (Coresonant Systems Private Limited) is an industrial IoT, RFID tracking, and embedded solutions provider based in Secunderabad. The company builds automated asset monitoring, intelligent access control, supply chain tracking, and smart telemetry systems for manufacturing, defense, logistics, and enterprise infrastructure.

companies.name: Cyrrup
companies.description: Cyrrup (Cyrrup Solutions Private Limited) is a smart mobility and IoT telematics hardware and software company based in Hyderabad. The company manufactures connected vehicle systems including Smart VTS (GPS vehicle tracking), Smart AIS-140 devices, and Smart Dashcams equipped with AI-based Driver Monitoring Systems (DMS) and Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) to detect fatigue, distraction, and road hazards in commercial transport fleets.

companies.name: Donatekart
companies.description: Donatekart (Donatekart Private Limited) is a social enterprise and in-kind crowdfunding platform incubated at T-Hub, Hyderabad. The platform replaces traditional unmonitored cash contributions with a transparent reverse-commerce model, allowing donors across the globe to procure and directly dispatch essential physical goods—such as groceries, blankets, medical supplies, and shelter kits—to verified NGOs and disaster-relief ground teams.

companies.name: Earthful
companies.description: Earthful (Earthful Nutrition Private Limited) is a clean-label D2C health and wellness brand based in Hyderabad. Founded by chemical engineers, the startup formulates and manufactures 100% plant-derived, whole-food supplements—including plant proteins, daily multivitamins, and micronutrient blends—completely free from synthetic additives, artificial flavors, and refined sugars.

companies.name: Esdy Information System
companies.description: Esdy Information System (Esdy Information System Private Limited) is an enterprise software development and IT services consultancy based in Somajiguda / Banjara Hills, Hyderabad. The firm delivers custom web and mobile application engineering, business workflow digitization, legacy system maintenance, and technology staffing services for domestic and regional businesses.

companies.name: FaceIntel
companies.description: FaceIntel (FaceIntel Technologies Private Limited) develops edge-native computer vision and video analytics systems for government and enterprise infrastructure. The platform runs continuous on-premise AI inference across live CCTV camera feeds to enable real-time identity continuity, crowd density tracking, automated employee attendance, and perimeter security without relying on continuous cloud video streaming.

companies.name: FarmRobo
companies.description: FarmRobo (FarmRobo Technologies Private Limited) is an agricultural robotics and deeptech startup incubated at the Technology Business Incubator (TBI), BITS Pilani Hyderabad campus. The company designs and manufactures autonomous farm rovers and AI-powered robotic systems for precision weed detection, targeted micro-spraying, soil sensing, and field monitoring to slash pesticide overuse and mitigate agricultural labor shortages.

companies.name: Froogal
companies.description: Froogal (Froogal Innovations Private Limited) is a B2B SaaS customer experience and marketing automation platform based in Hyderabad. The platform unifies offline POS transaction data with digital interaction touchpoints for retail, F&B, and consumer brands (such as Cream Stone, Big C, and The ThickShake Factory) to drive automated omnichannel loyalty rewards, churn prediction, and hyper-personalized customer engagement.

companies.description: Indrajaal (developed by Grene Robotics) is an autonomous anti-drone and wide-area security architecture. companies.name: Invilogic Software

companies.name: Jocata
companies.description: Jocata (Jocata Financial Advisory and Technology Services Private Limited, a subsidiary of BillDesk) is a digital lending infrastructure and RegTech platform based in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad. The company provides major banks, NBFCs, and FinTechs with end-to-end loan origination platforms, AI-driven credit scoring engines (SME DNA and Retail Persona Score), and regulatory compliance suites spanning AML transaction monitoring, customer due diligence, and fraud prevention.

companies.name: Kalpi

The platform enables retail and institutional investors to build, backtest, and automate systematic, rule-based equity and ETF trading portfolios with direct multi-broker execution, quantitative factor screening, and historical market simulations.

companies.name: Kalyan Group
companies.description: Kalyan Group (Kalyan Software Solutions Private Limited) operates a multi-service business practice based in Hyderabad. companies.name: Konax Technologies
companies.description: Konax Technologies (Konax Technologies Private Limited) is a digital product design studio and frontend engineering firm headquartered in Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad. companies.name: Leaf Craft
companies.description: Leaf Craft (Leaf Craft Private Limited) is an AI systems and orchestration software company incubated at the IIIT-Hyderabad campus. companies.name: Lunovian Technologies
companies.description: Lunovian Technologies (Lunovian Technologies Private Limited) is an enterprise IT services and technology consulting firm based in Uppal, Hyderabad. The company delivers end-to-end digital engineering services including custom full-stack web and mobile application development, cloud migration, automated DevOps pipelines, and enterprise systems integration for domestic and international clients.

companies.name: Marsmate
companies.description: Marsmate (Marsmate Business Intelligence Private Limited) is an enterprise data analytics and business intelligence software consultancy based in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad. companies.name: Neobric

companies.name: Tilli Software
companies.description: Tilli Software (Tilli Software India Private Limited) is a B2B FinTech product company developing customer communication and payment orchestration infrastructure. companies.name: UnoTeams
companies.description: UnoTeams (UnoTeam Software Private Limited) is an HRTech and workforce management SaaS platform. companies.name: WeMakeScholars
companies.description: WeMakeScholars (Wemakescholars Edtech Private Limited) is an education finance marketplace and EdTech/FinTech platform headquartered in Begumpet, Hyderabad. companies.name: ZennX Technologies
companies.description: ZennX Technologies (ZennX Technologies Private Limited) develops cloud-based order processing, distribution logistics, and pharmacy inventory software. The platform integrates pharmaceutical distributors, wholesalers, and retail pharmacies with automated stock replenishment, multi-tier pricing, invoice reconciliation, and real-time order tracking.

companies.name: Zyenac Solutions
companies.description: Zyenac Solutions (Zyenac Solutions Private Limited) is an enterprise cloud consulting and systems integration firm based in Madhapur, Hyderabad. companies.description: iSpatial Techno Solutions (iSpatialtec) is a specialized IT services and geospatial consultancy headquartered in Hyderabad with operations across the Middle East and North America. applications.subject: Inquiry About AI/ML & Software Engineering Opportunities – Teja Matta
applications.body:
Dear Newtrace Team,

I’m Teja Matta, a B.Tech Computer Science Engineering student at RGUKT, graduating in 2027. I’m reaching out to inquire about any current or upcoming internship or entry-level opportunities in AI/ML, Generative AI, AI Engineering, Data Science, or Software Engineering.

I have hands-on experience building production-style GenAI and ML systems, including RAG pipelines with hybrid retrieval and reranking, LLM fine-tuning using LoRA/QLoRA/PEFT, and multi-agent systems using LangGraph and ReAct. I’ve also built an AI-Powered Data Analyst Agent that reduced manual EDA time by 60% and an ML-based recommendation and forecasting platform.

My technical stack includes Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI/Claude APIs, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Pinecone, ChromaDB, FAISS, Docker, AWS, and SQL.

I’m looking for an opportunity where I can work on real-world AI systems, take ownership of engineering problems, and learn from an experienced team.

GitHub: https://github.com/teja05-45

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/teja-matta-602b3531a/

Portfolio: https://teja-matta-portfolio.vercel.app/

I’ve attached my resume for your consideration. Please let me know if there are any suitable opportunities available.

Best regards,

Teja Matta

B.Tech CSE | RGUKT

+91 8522074021

tejamatta05@gmail.com
